summary: Iteration 58 — Frontend-only verification of PM Toolkit upgrades (A) Client Portal + Change Orders + Milestone Pay and (C) Smart Scheduling / Crew Calendar. Logged in as pro@test.com (Explorer-active). Confirmed new project tab order Overview/Kanban/Timeline/Materials/Diary/Billing/Customer Page. CO create→send and Payment-request create work end-to-end. Public portal at /p/162u-Id59yUO4-qZc0w2Hw loads, shows the sent CO with line items, financials breakdown (Original €3.000 + Approved extras), Approve/Decline buttons + payments. Portal approve flipped the CO and bumped 'Updated total' from €3.482 → €3.857 (+€375 net, exactly matching CO-002 net). One CRITICAL bug found: 'Convert to invoice' on an approved CO navigates to /jobs/<originalJobId>/invoice which renders 'Job not found' and DOES NOT pre-fill Nachtrag line items. Also a doc/spec-vs-implementation mismatch on tab data-testids.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the 'Convert to invoice' button on an APPROVED change order navigates to '/jobs/<originalJobId>/invoice?from_project=<projectId>&from_co=<coId>' but the page renders 'Job not found' and shows ZERO line items. The CO line items + 'Nachtrag CO-...' note are NOT pre-filled. Specifically: project 6a283c58573a159e6192ab8d references job 6a283c58573a159e6192ab8c, which apparently no longer resolves in the invoice editor route. Reproduction: click 'Convert to invoice' on CO-001 (or freshly-approved CO-002) → lands on Job-not-found page.

Tab data-testids in the live app are pm-tab-overview / pm-tab-kanban / pm-tab-gantt / pm-tab-materials / pm-tab-diary / pm-tab-billing / pm-tab-share, but the feature spec (and likely any e2e tests) reference pm-billing-tab / pm-overview-tab style. Either the spec or the implementation needs to be aligned — recommend standardising on pm-tab-<key>.

After clicking portal-pay-qr-, the portal-pay-qrimg- element did not become visible in our run for the pre-existing payment (PAY-001). Could be initial state already open / toggle off, but it returned false twice. Needs a quick visual check by main agent to confirm QR is actually rendering an EPC image on first open.

integration_issues.issue: Endpoint or route /jobs/<jobId>/invoice does not honour the 'from_co' query param to load Nachtrag items, AND fails to resolve the original job. The CO conversion flow is currently end-user broken even though backend tests for /pm/change-orders pass.

[Follow-up] In the next iteration re-run the script to cover the untested items above (reject CO, schedule page, crew editor, 375px portal overflow, regression tab sweep). All blockers are environmental (browser/test timeout), not application bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: BillingTab convert-to-invoice handler appears to build the URL from project.from_job_id without verifying the job still exists OR without routing to a project-scoped invoice editor — this couples Nachtrag invoicing to the lifecycle of the original Job document, which is fragile (jobs can be deleted/archived). Recommend a /pm/projects/<id>/invoices/new?from_co=<coId> route that creates the invoice draft server-side from project + CO data, then redirects to the editor.
Tab-key convention inconsistency (pm-tab-<key> vs pm-<key>-tab) — adopt one rule project-wide to avoid future spec/test drift.

rca of the issue: Convert-to-invoice route mismatch: the button currently links to /jobs/<originalJobId>/invoice?from_project=...&from_co=... but the invoice editor's loader resolves <originalJobId> via the Jobs collection. For PM projects whose source job has been archived/removed (or for projects created without a backing job entry), the loader throws 'Job not found'. The from_co query param is therefore never consumed and Nachtrag line items never reach the editor. Two clean fixes: (a) add a project-scoped route /projects/<id>/invoice that doesn't require the original job; or (b) make the editor's data loader fall back to the PM project (when from_project is present) and use from_co to prefill items + 'Nachtrag CO-<num>' note.
